================================================================================
Case pattern with several quoted chunks
================================================================================

case "$(echo x)" in *"Copyright (c) "*"Uber"*) ;; esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (string
      (command_substitution
        (command
          (command_name
            (word))
          (word))))
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern)
      (string
        (string_content))
      (extglob_pattern)
      (string
        (string_content))
      (extglob_pattern))))

================================================================================
Case pattern ending in a quoted chunk
================================================================================

case x in *"a b"*"c d") ;; esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern)
      (string
        (string_content))
      (extglob_pattern)
      (string
        (string_content)))))

================================================================================
Case pattern with one quoted chunk
================================================================================

case x in *"a b"*) ;; esac
case x in *"(c)") ;; esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern)
      (string
        (string_content))
      (extglob_pattern)))
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern)
      (string
        (string_content)))))
